def solution():
    # Define variables
    face_value = 10000
    coupon_rate = 0.05
    discount_rate = 0.04
    years = 5

    annual_coupon = face_value * coupon_rate

    # Calculate the present value of coupon payments and face value
    pv_coupons = sum(
        annual_coupon / ((1 + discount_rate) ** year)
        for year in range(1, years + 1)
    )
    pv_face_value = face_value / ((1 + discount_rate) ** years)

    bond_value = pv_coupons + pv_face_value

    # Return the value rounded to the nearest integer
    return round(bond_value)
